model.name: Printed meander dipole (867 MHz)
model.description: Vertical printed dipole for a UAV with a non-metal (composite or foam) fuselage: it needs no ground plane. Each arm is a straight strip from the centre feed that ends in a meandered tip, printed as copper on one face of a 1.6 mm FR-4 board with a blade-like outline (x: flight axis, +x aft; z: up). A balanced 50 ohm lumped port bridges the centre gap; a real build needs a balun or a common-mode choke, and the coax is not modelled. Tuned about 1.3 % above 867 MHz for the 863-870 MHz SRD / LoRa band, as a margin for a radome. See examples/designs/README.md in the fairbeam repository.
